deskSetLogsMemoryOnly: The log is kept in memory only.

@deskSetLogsMemoryOnly.description: Toast text when the log folder cannot be opened because the log is not written to disk.

deskSetLogsClearDesc: Deletes the log files. A report sent later has only what is logged from now on.

@deskSetLogsKeep.description: Clear logs dialog: button that cancels.

@deskSetLogsClear.description: Clear logs dialog danger button and the Settings > Help > Logs button that opens it.

@deskSetLogsCleared.description: Toast title after the logs were cleared.

@deskSetLogsToday.description: Settings > Help > Logs: when detailed logging ends, today. {time} is a clock time like 14:02. Lowercase, part of a line.

@deskSetLogsTomorrow.description: Settings > Help > Logs: when detailed logging ends, tomorrow. {time} is a clock time like 14:02. Lowercase, part of a line.

@deskSetLogsTitle.description: Settings > Help: title of the Logs group.

deskSetLogsLevelNormal: Normal. Detailed keeps more lines on disk for 24 hours; addresses may appear in the file, reports leave them out.

@deskSetLogsLevelNormal.description: Settings > Help > Logs: text of the Log level row when the level is Normal.

deskSetLogsLevelDetailed: Detailed until {until}, then Normal. Addresses may appear in the file; reports leave them out.

@deskSetLogsLevelDetailed.description: Settings > Help > Logs: text of the Log level row when Detailed. {until} is like "today 14:02" or "tomorrow 14:02".

deskSetLogsLevelDetailedCore: Detailed until {until}, then Normal. Addresses may appear in the file; reports leave them out. Wallet core lines get detailed from the next app start.

@deskSetLogsLevelDetailedCore.description: Settings > Help > Logs: text of the Log level row when Detailed and the wallet core needs an app restart. {until} is like "today 14:02".

@deskSetLogsNormal.description: Settings > Help > Logs: segment for the normal log level. Short.

@deskSetLogsDetailed.description: Settings > Help > Logs: segment for the detailed log level. Short.

deskSetLogsSize: Current size {size} of {max}. Keeps one older file.

@deskSetLogsSize.description: Settings > Help > Logs: text of the Log files row. Sizes like "1.2 MB".

@deskSetLogsOpenFolder.description: Settings > Help > Logs: button that opens the log folder.
